timeline.description: ECI announced the 7-phase schedule for the 18th Lok Sabha elections.
timeline.impact: Model Code of Conduct (MCC) came into effect immediately across India.

timeline.description: Notification for Phase 3 (including Bhopal) was issued.
timeline.impact: Officially opened the window for candidate nominations in Madhya Pradesh.

timeline.description: Candidates filed their nomination papers and affidavits in Bhopal.
timeline.impact: Scrutiny occurred on April 20, and withdrawal window closed on April 22.

timeline.description: High-decibel campaigning by all major parties in the state capital.
timeline.impact: Silent Period began 48 hours before polling to allow voters a quiet reflection time.

timeline.description: Bhopal citizens cast their votes using EVMs and VVPATs.
timeline.impact: Significant turnout was recorded across Arera Colony, MP Nagar, and Old Bhopal.

timeline.description: Votes were counted simultaneously for all 543 constituencies.
timeline.impact: Alok Sharma (BJP) was declared the winner from the Bhopal seat.

key_steps.title: Voter Registration
key_steps.details: Bhopal recorded a massive surge in first-time voters (18-19 age group) this election.

key_steps.title: Model Code of Conduct
key_steps.details: Enforced strictly in MP to ensure level playing field during the 45-day campaign.

key_steps.title: EVM & VVPAT
key_steps.details: 100% VVPAT verification was conducted at randomly selected booths in Bhopal.

key_steps.title: First-Past-The-Post
key_steps.details: Winner declared based on highest votes polled among the 22 contesting candidates.

faqs.question: When did Bhopal vote in 2024?
faqs.answer: Bhopal voted in Phase 3 on May 7, 2024.

faqs.question: Who won the Bhopal Lok Sabha seat?
faqs.answer: Alok Sharma from the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) won the seat.

faqs.question: What was the result date?
faqs.answer: The results were declared on June 4, 2024.
